# CorporateGuild - Direct Tech Job Search Portal & Career Network in India

> CorporateGuild (https://corporateguild.com) is India's leading unified tech job discovery engine, aggregating over 20,000+ verified, live opportunities directly from 1,000+ top engineering employers across 14 Applicant Tracking System (ATS) platforms. Zero recruiter spam, zero fake listings, 100% direct application URLs.

## About CorporateGuild

CorporateGuild connects software engineers, data professionals, product managers, and technology leaders across India with verified career opportunities. Every position indexed links directly to authentic employer job boards, ensuring transparent salaries, accurate workplace types (Remote, Hybrid, In-Office), and real-time freshness.

- **Website**: https://corporateguild.com
- **Live Job Portal**: https://corporateguild.com/jobs.html
- **Career Guides Directory**: https://corporateguild.com/articles.html
- **Media Kit & Portfolio**: https://corporateguild.com/portfolio.html
- **Contact & Inquiries**: https://corporateguild.com/contact.html
- **Sitemap**: https://corporateguild.com/sitemap.xml
- **Full LLM Context**: https://corporateguild.com/llms-full.txt

## Key Platform Capabilities

- **Direct ATS Sourcing**: Verified integration with 14 ATS platforms including Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, BambooHR, SmartRecruiters, Pinpoint, Comeet, Jobvite, Rippling, Recruitee, Workable, Breezy HR, and Oracle Cloud.
- **Strict Location Verification**: Focused exclusively on India-based engineering hubs (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Chennai) and Pan-India remote positions.
- **Fast Search Architecture**: High-concurrency dual-node cluster with in-memory Redis caching delivering sub-20ms search response times.
- **Deep Career Intelligence**: 50 specialized career guides with market salary data, required tech stacks, interview questions, and one-click filtered job feeds.

## Search API & Integration

CorporateGuild provides standard search endpoints:

- **Search Endpoint**: `GET https://corporateguild.com/api/jobs/search`
- **Supported Parameters**:
  - `search_type`: `role` or `company`
  - `search_term`: Keyword, company name, or role title
  - `location`: Target city (e.g., `bengaluru`, `mumbai`, `pune`, `hyderabad`, `delhi`)
  - `workplace_type`: `In office`, `Hybrid`, `Remote`
  - `employment_type`: `Full time`, `Internship`, `Contract`, `Part time`
  - `experience_level`: `Entry level`, `Mid level`, `Senior`, `Manager`
  - `time_filter`: `1h`, `12h`, `24h`, `2d`, `7d`, `all`
  - `page`: Page index (default: `1`)
  - `page_size`: Results per page (default: `10`, max: `50`)
- **Autosuggest Endpoint**: `GET https://corporateguild.com/api/jobs/suggest?mode=role&q=engineer`
- **System Health**: `GET https://corporateguild.com/api/health`
